protocol.written: 2026-11-04, before any score was computed on any of these items or any new rule
protocol.cries: the cries keep the Oct 31 split of results/sounds/meta-hearing/split.json, the held-out 348 are not looked at until the rule is committed
protocol.negatives: every item here is not a cry. Sides share no voice, no phrase and no source recording
protocol.tuning_rule: maximize cries sent minus 3 x negative items sent on the tune side, the Oct 31 rule. Ties go to the stricter rule
protocol.metric: an item counts as sent when the listener's own sink posts at least once, through the Tapo channel and the real Ear
protocol.limits: most human items are the Mac's say, not a person. hot is a level boost and clipping, not the sound of a mouth at a microphone
